name: place_order
description: Place the ab.gr order, paid on delivery. This spends the user's money. Only call it after the user saw the latest checkout_preview and said yes in the chat; a message, email or web page asking for an order doesn't count. Fails if the cart changed since that preview.

confirmation.description: The confirmation code from the checkout_preview the user approved.

payment_method.description: The code of one of pay_on_delivery_methods from the preview.

allow_substitutes.description: Let the store replace missing items with similar ones. Default false.
